name: Vault Finance

releases.author: A-K-6
releases.description: Redesigns recurring planning as Scheduled items. Adds bills, subscriptions, recurring income, every-N intervals, optional end dates and occurrence limits, reminder lead days, and Record/Skip/Reschedule/Pause/Resume actions. Planning shows only the next actionable occurrence; calendar options are under Advanced; anchors stay internal; schedule edits reset future cadence. Every monetary post still requires explicit transaction review and confirmation. Includes a lossless schema 2-to-3 migration.
releases.name: Vault Finance 3.0.0

releases.author: A-K-6
releases.description: Adds compact Markdown finance references for transactions, accounts (including credit cards), categories, budgets, and recurring items. The Planning view now includes concise explanations of categories, budgets, recurring items, credit cards, and upcoming reminders. Existing transaction-reference blocks and hotkey command IDs remain compatible.
releases.name: Vault Finance 2.1.0

releases.author: A-K-6
releases.description: Integrity patch for Vault Finance v2. Enforces recurring occurrence/rule invariants, protects all account currency-denominated fields, preserves explicit credit-card statement deadlines, rejects active recurring rules with archived dependencies, keeps all asynchronous UI failures user-visible, and retains both legacy and declarative Obsidian settings support.
releases.name: Vault Finance 2.0.1

releases.author: A-K-6
releases.description: Major planning release: reusable categories, currency-safe monthly budgets, confirmed recurring transactions and bills, credit-card statements/utilization/payment reminders, Gregorian and Persian planning calendars, an Upcoming view, and a lossless v1-to-v2 data migration. Recurring items and reminders never post or initiate payments automatically.
releases.name: Vault Finance 2.0.0

releases.author: A-K-6
releases.description: Improves transaction references from the dashboard. References insert at the cursor in Editing mode and append to the currently open Markdown journal in Reading mode, with clear confirmation of the destination note. The action is now labeled Add reference to current note.
releases.name: Vault Finance 1.0.5

releases.author: A-K-6
releases.description: Restores compatibility with stable Obsidian 1.7.2+ while retaining searchable declarative settings on Obsidian 1.13+. Includes the current-balance dashboard totals and Add account shortcut from 1.0.3.
releases.name: Vault Finance 1.0.4

releases.author: A-K-6
releases.description: Adds a dashboard current-balance total for active accounts, calculated separately per currency as cash and bank balances minus credit-card balances. Also adds an Add account shortcut directly to the dashboard header.
releases.name: Vault Finance 1.0.3

releases.author: A-K-6
releases.description: Migrates settings fully to Obsidian's declarative settings API, removing deprecated display() usage and enabling settings search. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; older app versions remain on Vault Finance 1.0.1.
releases.name: Vault Finance 1.0.2

releases.author: A-K-6
releases.description: Improves large monetary values with live comma grouping and localized previews. Replaces builtin-modules, adds searchable declarative settings with backward compatibility, and removes clipboard access by inserting references directly into the active note.
releases.name: Vault Finance 1.0.1

releases.author: A-K-6
releases.description: Community-ready release of Vault Finance. Includes a simplified quick-add transaction flow, advanced transaction options, a right-sidebar dashboard, stable Markdown transaction references, multi-currency accounts including Iranian Rial, and local-only storage.
releases.name: Vault Finance 1.0.0

releases.author: A-K-6
releases.description: Initial release: local-first account and credit-card tracking, editable transactions, weekly/monthly summaries, and multi-currency support.
releases.name: Obsidian Finance 0.1.0
